records.part: Amendment #2 increasing quantities of labor, parts, and materials for repairs to Flygt pumps and motors
records.reason: The increase necessitated by this Amendment #2 is warranted due to the unforeseen amount of maintenance, repairs, and replacement parts needed on Flygt brand pumps and motors located at the City's wastewater lift stations and wastewater treatment plants.
records.installed_location: City's wastewater lift stations and wastewater treatment plants
